ttlDuration.description: time to live duration. Must be valid duration string. If not set the token will never expire.

Labels.description: Object that represents the labels of an object. Regex for keys: `^(?=.{1,63}$)([A-Za-z0-9][-A-Za-z0-9_.]*)?[A-Za-z0-9]$`. Regex for values: `^(?=.{0,63}$)(([A-Za-z0-9][-A-Za-z0-9_.]*)?[A-Za-z0-9])*$`. Providing a `null` value for a key will remove that key. Send empty object {} to remove all labels. The `stackit` prefix is reserved and cannot be used for Keys.
